This is a `.SRCINFO` metadata file for the wluma package, containing only package description, dependencies, source URLs, and checksums. No executable code, build scripts, or commands are present. LLM auditresponse for PKGBUILD:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD for wluma follows conventional Arch Linux packaging practices. It fetches the upstream source from the project's GitHub repository using a version-tagged tarball, provides BLAKE2 checksums, and uses standard Rust tooling (cargo fetch, cargo build, cargo test). The build step compiles the application and generates documentation with go-md2man. The package() function installs the binary, license, udev rules, a systemd user service, and man pages—all expected for a brightness control utility. No eval, base64, curl, wget, or other suspicious commands are present. Network activity is limited to fetching the verified upstream source and its signature, which is normal for AUR packages. There is no obfuscated code, data exfiltration, or execution of attacker-controlled scripts.
</details>
<evidence></evidence>
<summary>Standard AUR package with no malicious code</summary>
